scope: Hash-pinned installed compact DVQM; all selected GTRK placeholder intervals, native chunk source offsets and frame order bind independently parsed file fields to real loadSample output before configuration/audio. Byte identity is tested only for the listed fields; the discarded feature trailer is counted from file, not assigned to a native object field. Only two exact masks are accepted. All installed payloads stay in memory. Not original PCM analysis, maker identity, other formats/loaders, V4X Growl or whole Editor behavior.
